source: Novo Nordisk press release: Novo's Wegovy (semaglutide) reduced liver fat to normal (10-01-2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: Novo Nordisk press release: Novo's Wegovy (semaglutide) reduced liver fat to normal (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Post hoc exploratory analysis of the phase 3b STEP UP trials presented at EASD 2026 (not a pre-specified primary or secondary endpoint): in a STEP UP sub-population of 55 adults with obesity without diabetes whose liver fat was measured by MRI-PDFF, mean liver fat on Wegovy (pooled semaglutide 7.2 and 2.4 mg) declined from 8.8% at baseline to 3.1% at week 72; of the 26 participants who entered with liver fat above 5%, 88.5% (23 participants) reached the below-5% normal threshold by week 72. The wider pooled analysis covered 1,919 adults across STEP UP and STEP UP T2D (1,312 on semaglutide 7.2 mg, 304 on 2.4 mg, 303 on placebo). The release states Wegovy (semaglutide 2.4 mg) is approved for the treatment of MASH in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, China and several other markets; semaglutide 7.2 mg is not being investigated for MASH, and results from part 2 of the ongoing phase 3 ESSENCE MASH trial (1,197 participants, 240 weeks) are expected in 2029.
quarterly_data.figure: liver fat 8.8% to 3.1% at week 72 (n=55); 88.5% (23 of 26) reached below 5%; ESSENCE part 2 results expected in 2029
